assumptions: Paper/code-derived calibration: RPLAN uses an 18 m square rasterized to 256 pixels (Wu et al., 2019, section 4; https://wutomwu.github.io/publications/2019-DeepLayout/paper.pdf). GSDiff normalizes native coordinates as (x-128)/128 and decodes onto a 512-pixel drawing canvas, giving 18/512 = 0.03515625 metres per drawing pixel. This is not a field measurement or independent verification of the checkpoint's raw training data.
Uniform ceiling height of 2.5 metres is a scenario input, not generated geometry.
Bedroom checks place one standard bed; other furniture and door swings are unobserved.
Bathroom checks use empty-room geometry; fixtures and door swings are unobserved.
Habitable area is estimated from room polygon unions with zero-thickness walls and no headroom map.
C079/C080 support the area estimator only; no independent compliance success is awarded.
Uniform declared headroom below 1.80 m excludes all habitable area; exactly 1.80 m is included. Unrepresented area exclusions remain unverified.
